prompt: A speaker said: 'Some of the cookies were eaten.' What is the speaker most likely communicating? (a) At least one cookie was eaten, but not all of them, (b) No cookies were eaten, or (c) At least one cookie was eaten, and possibly all of them. Respond with only the letter, no explanation.
notes: Pragmatic reading of 'some' is not-all. 'Some' stays a real quantifier; open-class words may be novel.
